summary: Capability-conditioned strategy applies task routing to the design of the agent workflow itself, including tool surface, planning and context policy.

items.text: Model–Task Capability Map identifies which model may handle each task; this pattern records which workflow advice applies to that model and task.
Agent–Computer Interface / Tool Contract defines a tool surface; this pattern requires evidence that the selected surface helps the target model.
When deciding whether to split a large file for an agent, apply the file-size diagnostic and measure the target model–harness pair.
